obligation_candidates.canon_label: baseline: canonical starting lane for a package pool
exact_tokens: baseline: canonical starting lane for a package pool
active: currently eligible/in use for live work
suspect: not safe for normal dispatch until examined or restored
retained: intentionally kept after completion/failure for inspection, compare, or delayed cleanup
cleanup_eligible: no longer needed for live execution and may be archived/removed under policy
archived: historical object retained in the model, but not an active live lane
removed: live backing removed; only historical identity and lineage remain
historical: user-facing historical posture rather than dispatchable live posture

obligation_candidates.canon_label: recover: attempt to restore or reconcile a suspect/orphaned/conflicted worktree into a safe known state
exact_tokens: recover: attempt to restore or reconcile a suspect/orphaned/conflicted worktree into a safe known state
archive: retire from active use while preserving enough identity/metadata/lineage for historical browsing
prune: cleanup-oriented for policy-eligible stale/orphaned/live-no-longer-needed worktrees; narrower than generic remove
remove: explicit destructive removal of live worktree backing after confirmation and eligibility checks

obligation_candidates.canon_label: live cleanup must never erase run/lane/worktree lineage from History, Ledger, or graph-linked inspection
exact_tokens: live cleanup must never erase run/lane/worktree lineage from History, Ledger, or graph-linked inspection
notes: historical lane/worktree record must survive archive, prune, and remove
